title: Semidefinite Relaxations of the Gromov-Wasserstein Distance
tldr_zh: 用 SDP 松弛 GW 非凸 QP，给出可认证全局下界与最优性证书，实验中频繁达到全局最优
tldr_en: SDP relaxation of GW gives certifiable global lower bounds and optimality certificates, frequently exact in experiments
